name: red-team-review
description: Adversarial fact-check and pre-mortem for a claim, plan, launch or merge. The reviewer did not author the work and does not fix it. Instructions only.

interface.longDescription: Prove a claim or plan wrong before it ships. Frame testable statements, run a prosecutor and a defender separately, judge each one, then write a pre-mortem. The reviewer did not author the work and does not fix it.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $red-team-review to fact-check this claim before it ships.
